about: Recorded observations from the real SSAS 2025 tabular mirror on the VM, replayed against a running proxy by scripts/probe-parity.sh. Add a case whenever a review or VM session finds a proxy/reference difference, and record the MIRROR's value, not the proxy's. {catalog} and {cube} are substituted from the fields below, so the same case can be replayed against the mirror.
